description: True cost of a loan including fees: the US Truth in Lending APR (Regulation Z actuarial method) and the EU APRC (Consumer Credit Directive annual effective rate), plus the payment, amount financed, finance charge and total of payments for a level-payment loan. Handles origination fees and points paid upfront or rolled into the loan, a balloon payment, and weekly to annual payments. Compares the note rate with the real borrowing rate so offers can be ranked. Price: $0.002 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/loan-apr

balloon.description: Extra amount due with the last payment

fees.description: Prepaid finance charges (origination, points, broker fees)

feesFinanced.description: true: fees are added to the loan balance; false: paid upfront / deducted from proceeds

payment.description: Use this payment instead of computing it

points.description: Discount points as % of the loan amount (added to fees)
